faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can call the clinic directly, send us a WhatsApp message, or book online via our Practo profile. Walk-ins are also welcome during clinic hours.

faqs.question: Do I need to book in advance or can I walk in?
faqs.answer: Both are welcome. Walk-ins are accepted during clinic hours subject to doctor availability. For specific doctors or procedures, booking in advance is recommended.

faqs.question: What are the clinic timings?
faqs.answer: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM – 1:30 PM and 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM. Saturday evening closes at 8:30 PM. Closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: Is the clinic open on Sundays?
faqs.answer: No, the clinic is closed on Sundays. We are open Monday to Saturday, morning 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM and evening 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is the clinic open on public holidays?
faqs.answer: The clinic is closed on major public holidays. Please check our website or WhatsApp us to confirm availability on specific holidays.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, credit cards, debit cards, Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe and all UPI-based payments.

faqs.question: Do you accept health insurance?
faqs.answer: We accept select insurance plans. Please call the clinic or WhatsApp us with your insurance provider name to confirm coverage before your visit.

faqs.question: How much does a root canal cost?
faqs.answer: Root canal costs vary depending on which tooth is involved and the complexity. Please call or WhatsApp us for an accurate estimate — we are happy to guide you before you visit.

faqs.question: How much do dental implants cost?
faqs.answer: Implant pricing depends on the type and number of implants needed. We recommend a consultation for an accurate quote. Please call or WhatsApp us to get started.

faqs.question: What is MicroDentistry or microscope-assisted root canal?
faqs.answer: MicroDentistry uses a high-magnification dental operating microscope for root canal treatment. It allows better detection of canals, less tooth structure removal, fewer sittings, and improved outcomes compared to conventional root canal.

faqs.question: Is root canal treatment painful?
faqs.answer: Modern root canal treatment is performed under local anaesthesia and is largely painless during the procedure. Post-procedure discomfort is usually mild and manageable with medication.

faqs.question: How many sittings does a root canal take?
faqs.answer: Most root canals at Dentics are completed in 1 to 2 sittings thanks to our microscope-assisted technique. Complex cases may require more sittings.

faqs.question: Do you offer teeth whitening?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer professional laser teeth whitening which is faster and more effective than home kits. Results are typically visible in a single session.

faqs.question: What types of braces do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer metal braces, ceramic (tooth-coloured) braces, and clear aligner options. Our doctor will recommend the best option after an orthodontic assessment.

faqs.question: How long does a dental implant take?
faqs.answer: The implant process typically takes 3 to 6 months in total including healing time, and involves 2 to 3 visits. The result looks and functions like a natural tooth.

faqs.question: Do you do laser treatment?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer laser dentistry for gum treatments, cavity preparation, and soft tissue procedures. Laser treatment means less discomfort, faster healing, and often no need for stitches.

faqs.question: How does the clinic ensure sterilisation and safety?
faqs.answer: We use B-Class autoclaves, UV chambers, ultrasonic cleaners, and air purification systems. All staff wear full PPE and surfaces are disinfected between every patient.

faqs.question: Are digital X-rays safer than conventional X-rays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Digital X-rays emit up to 80% less radiation than conventional X-rays while producing higher-resolution images. All imaging at Dentics is done digitally.

faqs.question: Do you treat children?
faqs.answer: Yes, we treat patients of all ages including young children. Paediatric services include check-ups, fluoride treatments, pit and fissure sealants, and early orthodontic assessment.

faqs.question: How often should I visit the dentist?
faqs.answer: We recommend a routine check-up and cleaning every 6 months. Early detection of issues saves time, cost, and discomfort in the long run.

faqs.question: Is parking available near the clinic?
faqs.answer: Street parking is available on MM Road and adjacent lanes near Cox Town Circle. The clinic is also easily accessible by auto-rickshaw and BMTC bus.

faqs.question: Where exactly is the clinic located?
faqs.answer: Dentics Dental Care is at 12, 1st Floor, MS Plaza, MM Road, Cox Town, Bangalore – 560005. We are near the Cox Town Circle and the ITC flyover.

faqs.question: What dental emergency should I do?
faqs.answer: For dental emergencies such as severe toothache, knocked-out tooth, or broken tooth, please call or WhatsApp us immediately. We will prioritise emergency cases during clinic hours.
